name: Cascading Drainage Failure
description: IoT water depth surge corroborated by citizen report and traffic slowdown.
expected_behavior: Engine must cluster within 800m, assign high confidence (>0.75), and flag drainage_failure.
notes: Stress-tests multi-modal fusion across water sensor, citizen report, and road sensor.

name: Out-of-Order Delayed Arrival
description: High water reading arriving 30 mins after later observations.
expected_behavior: Engine sorts chronologically by event_time, not received_time.

name: Missing Coordinates Handling
description: Citizen report with textual location but null GPS coordinates.
expected_behavior: Engine must assign location 'UNKNOWN' without crash.

name: Conflicting Evidence Resolution
description: Citizen claims dry street while sensors measure 85 cm water depth.
expected_behavior: Engine penalizes confidence (-0.15), creates 'contradicts' edge, preserves evidence.

name: High Severity Low Confidence Guardrail
description: Single unverified citizen call reporting gas leak near school.
expected_behavior: Engine assigns Priority P1_CRITICAL and sets verification_required=True.

name: Highway Collision Standstill
description: Multi-vehicle highway crash with emergency call and CCTV blockage.
expected_behavior: Engine links accident and road blockage with High confidence.

name: Power Substation Sparking
expected_behavior: Engine assigns power_outage hypothesis and high priority.
